projects.title: Household Spend Tracker
projects.description: Personal pandas pipeline over open consumption survey extracts with a Tableau story exploring category elasticity by income band.

expected.rationale: Genuine depth on all five required skills, a statistics degree, and unusually mature deliverables argue pass, but eighteen months of full-time experience sits 25% short of the stated two-year minimum, and trading complete skill coverage against a hard tenure bar is exactly the call that belongs with a human.
